desc: American pub fare served with beer & cocktails in a lively microbrewery with outdoor seating.
addr: Allied Grand Plaza, 3rd, 8, Magrath Rd, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560025, India

rev.t: Went on Friday nite and it was packed, very loud as IPL match was on, plus RCB was playing so extra noise. Had the Stout nice and bitter like Guiness. Ginger beef fry was really tasty priced at 500. Spicy bbq pizza was nice too. Ok some of the food prices are on the higher side. Ambience is nice if you are with a large group.
